items.title: Protect Your Eggs
items.summary: On Sunday 13 September my son Jurre (7) and I built a game. He plays Roblox on his iPad, I wanted to see what happens when a child steers an AI agent himself. By the end of the evening there was a result: a multiplayer game, Protect Your Eggs. This post is about how that went, what the game does, and who took over when.
